name: @sanoma-ai/desktop
description: The Sanoma desktop shell: opens a company folder, runs its own sanoma launcher, and shows the app in a window

scripts.start: node scripts/electron.ts && pnpm run stage:resources && electron-forge start --
scripts.make: pnpm run stage:resources --arch arm64 --arch x64 && electron-forge make --arch arm64,x64
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/electron.ts && pnpm run package && playwright test
